description: One host's rendering of the IR. Provider-specific formatting is presentation; the delimited normative region must digest identically across all six.

authority.description: A projection never changes evidence or authority. Only the wrapper differs.

normative_digest.description: Digest of the delimited law. Six hosts, one value -- a renderer that reworded one line shows up here.

prefix_digest.description: The cacheable region. A prompt cache keys on it byte for byte; anything varying inside it makes every request a miss, and nothing errors.
